mapper.select: SELECT id, mold_id, plan_id, plan_name, reminder_type, interval_value, next_due_date, next_due_cycles, reminder_count, status, sent_at, operator_id, notes, created_at, updated_at FROM maintenance_reminders WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.mold_id, r.plan_id, m.mold_code, m.name AS mold_name, r.plan_name, r.reminder_type, r.interval_value, r.next_due_date, r.next_due_cycles, r.reminder_count, r.status, CASE r.status WHEN 1 THEN '待处理' WHEN 2 THEN '已提醒' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已忽略' ELSE '' END AS status_desc, r.sent_at, r.operator_id, u.real_name AS operator_name, r.notes, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM maintenance_reminders r LEFT JOIN molds m ON r.mold_id = m.id LEFT JOIN users u ON r.operator_id = u.id WHERE r.mold_id = #{moldId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
